text:
Maya C: quick accessibility check — keyboard focus on the p95 sparkline scrubber isn't visible when tabbing. Could we add a visible focus ring and a clear text alternative for screen readers? Also tooltip copy that just says 'p95' feels terse/confusing.

Thomas L: ack. I can add focus styles. What's the proposed accessible label? 'p95 latency (95th percentile)'? :+1:

Lee W: +1 to being explicit. For SRs I suggest aria-label="95th percentile latency for selected time range" — and add aria-live for updates.

Olivia P: microcopy suggestion: change tooltip from 'p95' to '95th percentile latency — 320 ms' or "95th percentile latency: 320 ms". That reads better in a quick hover.

Maya C: also thinking keyboard interactions: left/right to nudge scrubber by one bucket, shift+arrow for larger jump, space to pause live tailing. We should avoid collisions with other shortcuts.

Thomas L: sounds good. Plan: add tabindex=0 on the scrubber element, role="slider" with aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax/aria-valuenow, plus focus CSS. Quick CSS snippet: ```css
.sparkline-scrubber:focus { outline: 3px solid #4D9EF6; border-radius: 4px; }
```
I'll add storybook story + jest a11y check.

Lee W: caution: role=slider can change how up/down/left/right are interpreted by AT. We'll test NVDA/VoiceOver. Also ensure the scrubber announces buckets (e.g., "95th percentile latency, 320 ms, bucket 12 of 48"). Use aria-describedby to point to a visually-hidden label if needed.

Olivia P: visual note — use the new focus token (border color) for consistency. Confirm contrast for the ring is >= 3:1 vs panel background. I'll update the figma mock and attach a variant.

Maya C: acceptance criteria I'll add to the ticket: 1) visible focus ring when tabbing; 2) tooltip copy updated across heatmap, p95 card, and hover states; 3) arrow keys move scrubber by bucket and announce new value to SRs; 4) no new conflicts with global shortcuts; 5) a11y e2e smoke with NVDA/VoiceOver.

Thomas L: draft PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4821 (WIP) — includes CSS + aria attrs + keyboard handlers. Adding NVDA notes and test plan in the PR description.

Maya C: thanks! I'll review and then pair on NVDA. If we can get this into the next minor, it helps the accessibility audit. :folder:
